'''OT-3PO''' was a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked in a [[flophouse]] located in [[Gnawer's Roost]] in the sub-levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On one occasion, members of the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] came by in search of the technician [[Tavik Moern|Pavel Trenol]], who was staying in a room there. OT-3PO demanded a fee in return for telling them what room Trenol was staying in.

He was gray in color and was very rusty, covered in grime and had graffiti on him. He was also chained to the floor, something that he disliked as he couldn't understand why he wasn't trusted. However, he was very untrustworthy and would do anything for a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. He was programmed to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Binary/Legends|Binary]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]].<ref name="A Reckoning of Wraiths" />
